name: roboarena
description: RoboArena - Mini-jeux PvR (Player vs Robot) en ligne

scripts.db:schema: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const fs=require('fs'); const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}}); p.query(fs.readFileSync('./db/schema.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Schema OK');process.exit(0)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
